---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  margin: (top: 0.34in, bottom: 0.48in, x: 0.48in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.6pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 10pt,
      [Technology Commons - Weekly Progress + Learning Skills],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 9pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.46em, justify: false)

#let write-line() = line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.55pt + slate)

#let daily-box(day) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.56in,
  stroke: 0.65pt + mist,
  radius: 3pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 6pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 0.86in),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 11.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#day]
      #v(2pt)
      #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt,
        [#text(weight: "bold")[Goal:]],
        [#write-line()]
      )
      #v(4pt)
      #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt,
        [#text(weight: "bold")[By the end of class, I will have:]],
        [#write-line()]
      )
      #v(4pt)
      #text(weight: "bold")[Progress + proof:] #text(fill: slate)[What did you make, fix, test, practise, learn, or document?]
      #v(4pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(7pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(5pt)
      #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt,
        [#text(weight: "bold")[Next step:]],
        [#write-line()]
      )
    ],
    [
      #block(
        fill: sail,
        inset: (x: 6pt, y: 6pt),
        radius: 2pt,
      )[
        #text(size: 7.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[TEACHER CHECK]
        #v(4pt)
        #text(size: 7.4pt, fill: slate)[Progress]
        #v(2pt)
        #text(size: 9pt)[0  1  2  3  4]
        #v(5pt)
        #text(size: 7.4pt, fill: slate)[Evidence]
        #v(2pt)
        #text(size: 9pt)[0  1  2  3  4]
        #v(5pt)
        #text(size: 7.4pt, fill: slate)[Work habits]
        #v(2pt)
        #text(size: 9pt)[0  1  2  3  4]
      ]
    ]
  )
]

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 2.25in),
  column-gutter: 18pt,
  align: top,
  [
    #text(size: 21pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Weekly Progress Log]
    #v(1pt)
    #text(size: 9.4pt, fill: slate)[Plan the work. Do the work. Show the learning.]
  ],
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (0.52in, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#image("../brand/technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.48in)],
      [
        #text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
        #linebreak()
        #text(size: 7.2pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
      ],
    )
  ],
)
#v(4pt)
#line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
#v(3pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
#v(5pt)

#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1.2fr, auto, 0.8fr, auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 5pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
)
#v(7pt)

#daily-box([Monday])
#v(5pt)
#daily-box([Tuesday])
#v(5pt)
#daily-box([Wednesday])
#v(5pt)
#daily-box([Thursday])
#v(5pt)
#daily-box([Friday])

#pagebreak()

#let skill-row(title, prompt) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.14in,
  stroke: 0.65pt + mist,
  radius: 3pt,
  inset: (x: 9pt, y: 7pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 0.82in),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 10.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.2pt, fill: slate)[#prompt]
      #v(5pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [
      #block(fill: sail, inset: 6pt, radius: 2pt)[
        #text(size: 7.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[SELF-RATING]
        #v(5pt)
        #text(size: 10pt, weight: "bold")[E  G  S  N]
        #v(4pt)
        #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: slate)[Circle one]
      ]
    ]
  )
]

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 2.25in),
  column-gutter: 18pt,
  align: top,
  [
    #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning Skills: Show the Evidence]
    #v(1pt)
    #text(size: 9.2pt, fill: slate)[Use specific examples from this week. What did you actually do?]
  ],
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (0.52in, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 8pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#image("../brand/technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.48in)],
      [
        #text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
        #linebreak()
        #text(size: 7.2pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
      ],
    )
  ],
)
#v(4pt)
#line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
#v(3pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
#v(5pt)

#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 5pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
)
#v(4pt)
#text(size: 7.5pt, fill: slate)[E = Excellent   G = Good   S = Satisfactory   N = Needs Improvement]
#v(6pt)

#skill-row([Responsibility], [I meet commitments, use class time well, care for tools and materials, and complete what I say I will do.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Organization], [I plan my steps, keep tools, files, materials, and deadlines organized, and arrive ready to work.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Independent Work], [I start promptly, stay focused, use available resources, and persist before asking someone else to solve the problem for me.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Collaboration], [I contribute, listen, share space and tools, communicate clearly, and help others without taking over their work.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Initiative], [I notice what needs doing, ask useful questions, seek feedback, try ideas, and act on next steps without waiting to be told.])
#v(4pt)
#skill-row([Self-Regulation], [I manage distractions, use devices for learning, follow safety routines, respond to feedback, and adjust when something is not working.])

#v(6pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 10pt,
  [
    #text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[One learning skill I want to strengthen next week:]
    #v(5pt)
    #write-line()
    #v(8pt)
    #write-line()
  ],
  [
    #text(size: 8.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Teacher note / next step:]
    #v(5pt)
    #write-line()
    #v(8pt)
    #write-line()
  ]
)
```
